facts.fact: The Liberian Investigator reports Executive Order 147 mandates biometric ID cards for all citizens and residents, and the National Identification Registry is procuring a system, with a presidential memo of 5 July 2025 setting an April 2026 rollout deadline while the PPCC ordered international competitive bidding.

LBR.note: OSD pre-financing is reported and disputed with no signed lawful contract; no amount is a signed deal.
